verdict.rationale: SolidJS's explicit signal-based reactivity with automatic dependency tracking (solid-gh-10, solid-gh-1, solid-gh-9) gives developers a predictable, traceable data flow instead of implicit two-way bindings, and hands-on users confirm this makes state changes 'intuitive and easy to debug' and eliminates ref/callback bookkeeping compared to React (solid-comm-10, solid-comm-4, solid-comm-7). Minor friction is noted (props must be functions, some API non-intuitiveness) but doesn't contradict the core traceability claim. Missing for 10: dedicated first-party devtools/debugging documentation (one comment even calls Solid's devtools 'alpha/unusable', solid-comm-15) and independent benchmarking of debuggability specifically.
